name: Miami University
tuition_note: Ohio/reciprocal resident tuition & fees ($18,890) and combined Housing and Food ($17,668), from the 2027-2028 Undergraduate Annual Cost Estimates at miamioh.edu/admission-aid/costs-financial-aid/cost-of-attendance.html. The housing-rates page publishes only per-semester room-only rates that vary by room type (no single annual room-only figure), so the officially published combined room+board annual figure was used.
